supply_chain_findings: Constructing the default CLI model downloads weights.pth and image_resizer.pth when the checkpoint is absent.
The checkpoint downloader follows redirects and writes downloaded bytes without a pinned artifact hash.
The wheel contains no inference weights, so an offline fixed-corpus comparison is not available from the wheel alone.
The metadata does not declare a Requires-Python bound, so Python 3.12 compatibility is not established by packaging metadata.
The dependency set is materially larger than the current ResearchMind runtime and needs a separate Windows CPU/GPU packaging spike.

decision.reason: The license is acceptable, but offline weight provenance, pinned downloads, Python 3.12 and Windows packaging, model size, cold start, CPU latency and fixed-corpus quality are not proven.
decision.g5_effect: No local model dependency or weight is adopted. The narrow FormulaRecognizer boundary remains available for a later local adapter.
